Invisalign clear aligners: A series of clear, removable aligners that gradually straighten your teeth. They are made with SmartTrack material, designed for comfort and controlled tooth movement.
Traditional braces: Fixed appliances that use brackets and wires to move your teeth.
Other clear aligners: Other brands also offer removable clear aligners, but Invisalign treatment includes care from an Invisalign-trained doctor.
